notes: ACCESS: shopterrain.com is Datadome-protected (window.ddjskey present; direct curl and a 21-profile curl_cffi sweep both returned 403 - chrome116/119/123 punched through once then stopped, confirming the brief's 'unstable winning profile' warning). Working route was r.jina.ai with the 'x-return-format: html' header, which returns the un-stripped SSR document including the URBN monoweb script id=urbnInitialPiniaState blob. robots.txt (read via jina) has NO Claude-specific disallow - only /orchestration/, /api/, /cgi-bin/, /blog/wp-content/, /homepage. STRUCTURE: taken from the Pinia state rather than the mega-menu - superNav.navItems['shopping-root'] gives the 9 top-level nav slugs and each page's catchAll.navItem gives parentSlug/childSlugs, so every branch was enumerated exactly. Full shopping tree: New / Halloween / Kitchen + Tabletop / Decor / Outdoor Living / Furniture / Planters + Garden Utility / Gifts / Sale. Confirmed complete - the footer nav carries no product categories, and /wall-decor and /mirrors both 404. Terrain has no wall-art or mirror node at all: the Product Type facet on /decor shows just 1 'Mirrors' item and 35 'Art & Wall Accents' items, none with their own listing page. COUNT VERIFICATION (Rule 1): every qty was exhaustion-checked, not taken on trust. category.totalRecordCount equals the rendered 'N products' header (verified against the jina markdown render of /decor-baskets, which prints '40 products' three times). Each listing was then paged to exhaustion and the product tiles' productIds collected and deduplicated. 4 of 8 leaves matched exactly (decor-lighting, outdoor-lighting, decor-vases, drinkware). 4 leaves were inflated by colorway records rendered as separate tiles for the same productId - the exact pattern the brief flags from Quince Home / Indigo Home - so the deduplicated distinct-product count is used: baskets 40 to 38, serveware 130 to 127, garden-accents 113 to 112, planters 347 to 333. On /all-planters (and on the dropped /outdoor-decor) the reported total also exceeds the number of tiles the site actually renders by 6, so 341 tiles / 333 distinct is the empirically verified figure. No qty is estimated; no nulls. CORPORATE-SIBLING DETERMINATION (NOT a duplicate): Terrain shares the URBN monoweb platform with Anthropologie (S.N. 7 / 138) and Urban Outfitters Home (S.N. 77) but is a fully independent catalogue. Evidence: sites.siteId is 'tr-us', versus 'an-us' on anthropologie.com and 'uo-us' on urbanoutfitters.com (both read live this session via the same route); product IDs are namespaced per banner - Terrain's are all TR-<id>-000 versus UO-<id>-000, and intersecting Terrain's 90 vase productIds with Urban Outfitters' glassware listing returned 0 overlap; the category slugs, categoryIds and nav tree are entirely Terrain's own (GARDEN-ALL-PLANTERS, GARDEN-ACCENTS, DECOR-VASES etc.). RULE 0 GAINS: /outdoor-lighting (69) is fully in scope as Lighting per Rule 0.2 despite the 'Outdoor' room word - solar lanterns, stake lights and string/garden light sets. RULE 0.6 OVERLAPS (documented, both nodes kept - genuine separate nav branches, not facet re-cuts): (1) outdoor-lighting sits under Outdoor Living while decor-lighting sits under Decor; their productId sets overlap by 68 of outdoor-lighting's 69, with decor-lighting (102) the superset holding 34 additional items. Both kept: distinct nav branches under different parents with different URLs and non-identical listings. (2) /all-planters and /garden-accents both overlap the dropped /outdoor-decor roll-up heavily (see below). DROPPED ROLL-UPS (mixed; verified by reading titles and comparing productId sets, not names): '/decor' Shop All Decor (1199) - a Shop All page and a genuinely mixed roll-up whose own Product Type facet is 286 Plants & Flowers, 223 Holiday Decor, 201 Candles, 157 Candle Accessories. '/outdoor-decor' (reported 288, 282 rendered) - a super-set roll-up, not a leaf: its productId set contains 111 of garden-accents' 112, 21 of 21 birding, 18 of 19 doormats and 107 of all-planters, plus Sunbrella outdoor pillows and alpaca throws (textiles). Dropped to avoid double-counting the leaves that are emitted. '/candles-tapers-holders' (389) - the site's own page title is 'Candles & Home Fragrance | Terrain'; reading all 385 distinct titles shows roughly half are scented, jar and beeswax candles, Linnea diffusers, incense, wax melts, matchboxes, citronella and a pillow mist, i.e. the excluded Home Fragrance node. It has no child node isolating the in-scope holders, lanterns and candelabra, so dropped rather than padded - consistent with S.N. 77, which dropped its equivalent 'candles' node. '/plant-stands' (47) - mixed: plant stands and pedestals alongside side tables, stools and a bookshelf (furniture); 42 of its 47 productIds already sit inside all-planters. '/birding' (21) - a marketing-root node, and all 21 productIds are already inside garden-accents. OTHER EXCLUSIONS: Holiday & Gift in full (the Halloween nav branch, halloween-shop, holiday-lighting, holiday-tree-ornaments, holiday-wreaths, christmas-trees, thanksgiving-table, easter, hanukkah, all Gifts branches, and the marketing-root seasonal shops); New Arrivals, Sale, and all marketing-root theme shops (decorative-tray-shop, floral-decor-shop, copper-metallic-decor-shop and similar) as facet/theme re-cuts; '/decorative-botanicals' (379) and '/garlands' (99) as faux, dried and preserved botanicals; '/throws-pillows' (27), '/kitchen-linens' (156) and '/doormats' (19) as textiles and rugs; kitchen-tools-gadgets and kitchen-pantry (cookware and food); the entire Furniture branch including outdoor sofas, chairs, tables, benches and storage-utility; garden-tools, garden-tools-watering, potting-supplies, bulbs-seeds, plants-flowers, garden-apparel, outdoor-fire-pits and sun-insect-protection. SEASONAL LEAKAGE: Terrain is mid-Halloween programme and seasonal product leaks into every general decor node (pumpkin stake sets in garden-accents, Halloween Icon plates in serveware, Jack-o-Lantern solar lanterns in decor-lighting). These sit inside the general nodes with no separable holiday sub-node, so node totals are reported as the site reports them; the dedicated Holiday and Halloween branches are dropped.
